channel.title: zyekh.com — Technical Articles & Security Insights
channel.description: Technical articles, Linux kernel news, system hardening guides, and cybersecurity research by Zyekh Abdul Qadir Jailani.

item.title: Linux Auditd Blueprint: Real-Time Kernel Event Tracking & Security Auditing
item.description: Security guide for configuring Linux Audit Framework (auditd) to log execve system calls, file integrity changes, and privilege escalation events.

item.title: Process Isolation on Linux: Unprivileged User Namespaces & Chroot Jails
item.description: Technical blueprint for configuring unprivileged user namespaces and chroot jails to sandbox untrusted services without full container runtimes.

item.title: Cilium eBPF & Tetragon: Cloud-Native Runtime Security & Network Enforcement
item.description: Deep-dive guide on deploying Cilium eBPF for zero-trust network policy enforcement and Tetragon for real-time kernel event monitoring in Kubernetes.

item.title: ColBERT Late Interaction: Advancing RAG Beyond Dense Embeddings
item.description: How late interaction retrieval models solve the lost-in-the-middle problem and dramatically improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation precision over standard single-vector embeddings.

item.title: Container Image Signing & SLSA Provenance Verification with Sigstore Cosign
item.description: Supply chain security guide on signing OCI container images keylessly and verifying SLSA build provenance using Sigstore Cosign and Rekor.

item.title: DSPy: Replacing Prompt Engineering with Declarative Optimization Compilers
item.description: Why manual prompt tweaking is obsolete. Learn how to compile and optimize LM pipelines using DSPy declarative modules and metric-driven teleprompter algorithms.

item.title: High-Speed eBPF/XDP Packet Filtering for Linux Server DDoS Mitigation
item.description: Technical guide for writing eBPF eXpress Data Path (XDP) kernel programs to drop malicious DDoS traffic at the network driver level.

item.title: Automated Intrusion Prevention: Fail2ban Configuration for SSH & Nginx Protection
item.description: Comprehensive blueprint for deploying Fail2ban to detect brute-force attacks, automate IP bans via iptables/nftables, and configure recidive long-term bans.

item.title: HTTP/3 & QUIC Protocol Security Hardening: Mitigating 0-RTT Replay Attacks
item.description: Production blueprint for hardening HTTP/3 and QUIC transport protocols, mitigating 0-RTT replay vectors, and configuring UDP rate limiting.

item.title: Kubernetes Pod Security Standards (PSS) & Native Admission Control
item.description: Production guide on enforcing Privileged, Baseline, and Restricted Pod Security Standards (PSS) using native Kubernetes admission controllers.

item.title: KV Cache INT4 Quantization for 1M+ Token Context Windows
item.description: Squeezing massive context windows into consumer GPUs by quantizing the Key-Value cache down to 4-bit precision without losing retrieval accuracy.

item.title: High-Throughput Linux Audit Logging with Vector & ClickHouse DFIR Pipeline
item.description: Architecture guide on building a high-throughput Linux kernel audit logging pipeline using Vector log forwarder and ClickHouse for real-time DFIR forensics.

item.title: Linux Kernel Sysctl Hardening: Securing TCP/IP Network Stack against SYN Floods
item.description: Hardening guide for tuning Linux kernel sysctl parameters to defend against TCP SYN floods, IP spoofing, packet redirects, and memory exhaustion.

item.title: Linux Landlock LSM: Unprivileged Application Sandboxing & Access Control
item.description: Engineering guide on using the Landlock Linux Security Module to enforce unprivileged file system and network access control restrictions.

item.title: Linux Seccomp-BPF Syscall Filtering: Restricting Process Attack Surfaces
item.description: Step-by-step engineering blueprint for implementing Seccomp-BPF syscall filters to restrict Linux process capabilities and block zero-day kernel exploits.

item.title: Comprehensive Linux VPS Hardening Blueprint for 2026
item.description: Production-grade security blueprint for Debian and Ubuntu Linux servers. Includes SSH key enforcement, kernel sysctl parameters, UFW rate-limiting, Fail2Ban auditing, and automated updates.

item.title: Why Minimalist Static Hosting Outperforms Monolithic Frameworks for Security
item.description: Architectural analysis comparing static edge hosting to monolithic server frameworks. Examines attack surface reduction, TTFB performance benchmarks, zero server maintenance, and pure CSS design systems.

item.title: Serving Mixture of Experts (MoE): Memory-Efficient Inference Routing
item.description: Deep dive into the gating router mechanisms of Mixtral 8x7B and DeepSeek-V2, expert parallelism strategies, and VRAM memory offloading patterns across multi-GPU setups.

item.title: Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestration: Hierarchical Agentic Workflows
item.description: Designing recursive agent loops, tool-calling pipelines, state graph transitions, and autonomous swarm routing for complex software engineering automation.

item.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy Security Hardening Blueprint for 2026
item.description: Production guide for hardening Nginx reverse proxies with TLS 1.3, rate limiting, buffer overflow defense, and security headers.

item.title: OmniRouter Architecture: Resilient LLM Gateway Routing & Fallback Pipelines
item.description: Advanced API routing techniques for multi-LLM architectures, mitigating rate limits, and ensuring speculative decoding fallbacks across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source nodes.

item.title: Enforcing Linux Account Lockout Policies with PAM Faillock against Brute Force
item.description: Security guide for configuring pam_faillock to prevent SSH and console brute-force authentication attacks on RHEL, Debian, and Ubuntu systems.

item.title: Rust in the Linux Kernel: Securing Core Subsystems & Memory Safety
item.description: Comprehensive engineering guide on how Rust eliminates spatial and temporal memory vulnerabilities in modern Linux kernel drivers and network modules.

item.title: Implementing Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) & Security Headers
item.description: Comprehensive technical guide for configuring strict Content Security Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options, and Nginx security headers.

item.title: S-LoRA: Multiplexing Thousands of Fine-Tuned Adapters on a Single GPU
item.description: How Unified Paging and scalable LoRA adapter serving allows cloud platforms to host 10,000+ custom fine-tuned models concurrently on a single GPU without OOM errors.

item.title: Short-Lived SSH Certificate Authentication with HashiCorp Vault CA
item.description: Zero-trust SSH architecture blueprint for eliminating static SSH public keys using HashiCorp Vault Certificate Authority and short-lived certificates.

item.title: Structured Output Generation: Enforcing JSON & Regex at the Logits Level
item.description: Bypassing brittle prompt engineering by directly manipulating LLM token logits to mathematically guarantee valid JSON schema outputs without retry loops.

item.title: Systemd Service Sandboxing: Restricting Process Capability & System Calls
item.description: Production guide for sandboxing Linux daemons using systemd security directives like ProtectSystem, SystemCallFilter, and CapabilityBoundingSet.

item.title: UFW Firewall Hardening: Advanced Rate Limiting & Default-Deny Security Blueprint
item.description: Production guide for securing Linux servers using UFW with default-deny policies, custom application profiles, rate limiting, and interface isolation.

item.title: Understanding eBPF for Real-Time Linux Security Monitoring
item.description: Technical deep-dive on Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) tracing, kprobes, tracepoints, bpftrace, and zero-overhead kernel runtime security monitoring.

item.title: vLLM PagedAttention: Memory Optimization & High-Throughput LLM Inference Tuning
item.description: Deep dive into OS-inspired virtual memory management for LLM KV caches, maximizing GPU utilization, and achieving 20x throughput scaling for production inference.

item.title: WebGPU LLM Inference: Running 7B Models Natively in the Browser
item.description: Leveraging WebGPU compute shaders, TVM WebAssembly, and WGSL pipelines to run private local LLMs entirely within client-side browser sandboxes without server infrastructure.

item.title: Securing VPS Infrastructure with WireGuard Mesh VPN Tunnels & Strict Firewall Rules
item.description: Step-by-step technical blueprint for creating encrypted private mesh networks between multi-cloud VPS nodes using WireGuard and UDP noise protocols.

item.title: Zero-Trust Microservices with WebAssembly (Wasm) Runtime Sandboxing
item.description: Architecture blueprint for running untrusted microservice code inside WebAssembly sandboxes with nanosecond startup times and linear memory bounds.

item.title: Zero-Trust SSH Access Blueprint: FIDO2 Hardware Keys & SSH Certificate Authority
item.description: Comprehensive technical blueprint for securing Linux SSH infrastructure using FIDO2/YubiKey hardware tokens, SSH Certificate Authority (SSH CA), and short-lived certificates.
